notes: GitHub model_card.md only points to Appendix D of arXiv:2205.01068; extracted from the PDF paper (30 pages). Appendix A NLP zeroshot/multishot and Figures 3–5 are charts without readable numeric cells, so those capability averages and RealToxicityPrompts bucket rates were omitted. Two-column PDF layout split some sentences (e.g. MSC UF1); quotes are contiguous fragments only. Seed covers all OPT sizes linked in the card; numeric tables mainly report OPT-175B vs Davinci/dialogue baselines. No external auditor organizations are named as testers of OPT.
